content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ogden

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects—before you apply. Granite PM Academy can clarify whether your background meets the standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive sessions on your schedule, covering all five PMBOK domains. This formal coursework satisfies PMI's education requirement and prepares you directly for exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI, document your project experience, and pay the exam fee. Your application confirms eligibility and reserves your exam seat. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Pass the 180-question, four-hour proctored exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and resources. Renew your credential on schedule to maintain recognition across your local job market.
